WITH sep_sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) / SUM(f.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sep_sales f
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = f.ss_ticket_number
 AND sr.sr_item_sk = f.ss_item_sk

WITH june_sales AS (
  SELECT d.d_year AS yr, ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_moy = 6 AND d.d_year IN (2001, 2002)
)
SELECT j.yr,
       ROUND(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) / SUM(j.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM june_sales j
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = j.ss_ticket_number
 AND sr.sr_item_sk = j.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY j.yr
ORDER BY j.yr;
